t: A tiny, thrifty Texas Instruments chip that sips power for years on small batteries.
steps: Buy an MSP-EXP430G2ET or MSP-EXP430FR2433 LaunchPad from DigiKey or another electronics distributor.
Get a micro-USB cable that carries data.
Install the free Code Composer Studio from Texas Instruments.
Plug in the LaunchPad and let the computer find its built-in debugger.
Import the blink LED example for your LaunchPad.
Build and run the example and watch the LED flash.
Change the delay in the code and run it again.
meta: Open Board. From $8.80. A few stores.
